title: 建築施工
subtitle: Building Construction
teachers:
SUDA Tatsuru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Gain basic knowledge of architectural operations for safe and comfortable buildings.

Understand construction techniques for various engineering works.
advice:
This is a basic course in architectural materials science. We will cover the following topics:

1. Summary of architectural operations
2. Construction management
3. Execution schemes
4. Frame structure construction
5. Construction of functional aspects and finishing of buildings

Students are required to prepare by reading the textbook in advance.
Students are required to submit a report on their preparations.
Students will observe construction work and discuss it.
books: 建築生産　井畑耕三　オーム社

activityGoals.body: Students understand construction procedures and explain the role of the architectural engineer.
Students understand the standard procedures for construction management and explain their important points.
Students understand the value of buildings and the ethics of architectural engineers.
